arguments.source:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
import pluck as entries from dw::Core
fun add(n)=log(n+1)
---
{
 object: entries({a:2}, (v,k,i) ->
  add(v) + i),
 sequence: 1 to 4 flatMap [$,$+1] distinctBy $ takeWhile ($<4) sumBy $,
 groups: [1,2,3] groupBy ($ mod 2),
 ordered: [3,1,2] orderBy $,
 strings: "a🐈" mapString upper($),
 tree: {a:[1,2]} mapLeafValues ($*2),
 joined: outerJoin([1,2],[2,3],$,$),
 partitioned: [1,2,3] partition ($>1),
 lines: "a\nb" readLinesWith "UTF-8",
 scanned: "a1" scan /(\d)/,
 fallback: null onNull "ok",
 guarded: 2 failIf ($>5),
 waited: 3 wait log("never")
}
